extension.summary: يعرض معلومات مخصصة عن عملية المشغل
显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: يفتح نافذة مستقلة لمعلومات العملية. تعرض هذه النافذة تفاصيل برنامج الترميز (Codec) والفيديو والصوت الخاصة بالوسائط التي يتم تشغيلها حاليًا.
Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
Megnyit egy külön folyamatinformációs ablakot. Ez az ablak az aktuálisan lejátszott média kodek-, videó- és hangadatait jeleníti meg.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news: v2.15.2 - Web dashboard: the token travels in a request header only, never in a URL; the live stream and pictures use a session cookie instead. - Web dashboard: reading without the token works on the home network only, and the lockout after wrong tokens counts per device. - Web dashboard: fixed shelves that went wrong while the library changed or during a search, the cover tint, the bar colour on load; a dashboard that cannot start is now handled cleanly. - Resume points, frame rates and luminance values Kodi reports as invalid no longer break the display. - Colour settings with non-Latin digits are read correctly, and missing translations fall back to English. - Share passwords no longer appear in the log.
